name: mimetypes
description:
Dear team,

Please note the current list of MIME type associations we are using for our assets: JSON files (the “.json” extension) are served with application/json, HTML pages (“.html”) with text/html, and PNG images (“.png”) with image/png. Compressed archives that carry the “.tar.gz” extension should be identified as application/gzip, while JavaScript source files (“.js”) are to be labeled as application/javascript. 

Make sure these mappings are reflected in the server configuration and any content‑type handling logic moving forward. Let me know if you encounter any discrepancies.
